corrections: Expose all 64 oneHAR/MOSAIC main target scores in the primary literature UI.

DeepConvLSTM original weighted-F1: 0.915 with Null and 0.866 without Null; retain A&D macro-F1 as a different protocol.
Keep original avg columns when complete dataset sets match. oneHAR joint published Accuracy .933 vs equal-weight per-target mean .9222.
Keep OPPORTUNITY 4-class, 17-gesture no-Null and 18-class including-Null tasks distinct; retain PAMAP2 9/12 and USC-HAD 7/12 variants.
limitations: IF-ConvTransformer 2022 original full text could not be retrieved. The same authors’ TSF Table 4 comparison scores were rechecked; they remain explicitly labelled as comparison results.
Some saved runs have only historical registry evidence. No new training or inference was executed.
Original-paper figures/tables and author-preprint versions do not establish that their protocols are mutually comparable.
